wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Kadnase yon fonksyon pou yon semèn, dez semèn, yon mwa oswa pou tout tan. Bouton kriz la, èd apre rechit, kontak rele an sekirite ak efase done pa janm kadnase.

community.noPhone: Nimewo telefòn pa janm parèt nan mesaj kanmarad.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Kenbe sponnsò ou oswa kontak an sekirite ou a yon touche.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Sa efase done ou yo tout bon, san retou.
safety.wipeConfirm: Mwen konprann sa efase done mwen yo tout bon.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Konsèy yo anonim. Nimewo pa janm parèt.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Kisa ki te ede ou nan etap sa a?
reentry.crisisStep: Sove nimewo sa yo kounye a. Ou ka peze "Need help now" anwo nenpòt ekran tou.
reentry.resourceOnly: Gid resous sèlman — Groundwork pa bay sa epi li pa asosye ak okenn founisè.

steps.step4: Fikse objektif ak konseye ka ou
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Tcheke papye liberasyon ak dènye dat yo
steps.step10: Konfime premye dat tchèk-in ak kondisyon yo
steps.step13: Jwenn telefòn, imèl ak entènèt gratis
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step29: Louvri kont labank epi fè bidjè
steps.step31: Rekonekte ak fanmi ou, epi regle pansyon si se ka a
steps.step33: Fikse yon objektif long epi fete 90 jou ou

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Prive pa defo. Pataje sèlman si ou deside.

family.help: Fanmi wè sèlman sa ou chwazi pataje.

phase3.resumeHelp: Fè rezime tèks senp ak eksperyans ou.
phase3.headline: Tit
phase3.interviewHelp: Pratike repons ou yo. Antrenè a ba ou nòt ak yon konsèy.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Jwenn yon mantò oswa tounen mantò.
phase3.geoHelp: Se vil ou sèlman lòt moun wè. Kote egzak la pa janm pataje.
phase3.rideHelp: Mande woulib. Nimewo pa janm parèt. Rankontre nan plas piblik.
phase3.partnersHelp: Ti gwoup twa ki soutni youn lòt.
phase3.caption: Lejann
phase3.qaHelp: Poze kesyon san non. Moun ki pi devan yo reponn.
phase3.merchHelp: Sèlman mak kode. Deyò pa di sa yo vle di, pa gen dat enprime.
phase3.shareHelp: Yon kat ak chif pwogrè ou.
phase3.archiveHelp: Sele yon mo pou ou. L ap louvri jou jalon.
phase3.matchHelp: Ajan ou pale ak lòt ajan yo anvan. Drag la koupe pou kounye a. Ou ka wè poukisa, mande prezantasyon epi re-eseye.
phase3.datingOff: Drag la koupe jis règ jou minimòm soti.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Gade isit anvan. Opsyonèl, nivo vil sèlman: wè ki moun k ap ale nan reyinyon ou epi konekte pa mesaj nan apli. Pa gen telefòn, pa gen kote egzak.
phase3.groupsHelp: Gwoup rekiperasyon, retou, lafwa ak kominote pa vil ak lè reyinyon. Done echantiyon sèlman — pa vrè lis.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Montre sèlman lè pèsonn sou tablo a pa ale nan reyinyon ou. Li pibliye yon demann verifye nan apli — nivo vil sèlman, pa gen telefòn.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Pa gen kowolituraj pou reyinyon sa a, kidonk woulib parèt kòm rezèv.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Chofè apwouve sèlman. Yo prevni youn pa youn, tann 2 minit; ou konfime anvan yo prevni pwochen an.
phase3.pingConfirm: Konfime anvan yo prevni pwochen an
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: mwa pou rive nan objektif ou
phase3.musicHelp: Moso echantiyon sèlman. Pa gen kont difizyon. Koupe anndan akademi ak modil yo.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Mizik koupe lè ou nan modil.
phase3.shareWho: Kounye a: ou sèl. Kreye lyen kite moun ki gen lyen an li.
phase3.suggestHelp: Sijesyon sèlman — anyen pa pibliye jis ou ajoute.
